title: U.S. House · New York's 25th District
area: Monroe County, including the city of Rochester and surrounding suburbs.

context.text: Incumbent Joseph Morelle defeated Robin Wilt and Sherita Traywick in the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary, 63.3%-30.6%-6.0%. The Republican and Conservative primaries were canceled; Virginia McIntyre advanced without appearing on either ballot.

summary.text: Joseph Morelle is the Democratic and Working Families Party incumbent, a former Monroe County legislator and New York State Assembly majority leader first elected to the House in a 2018 special election. He is ranking member of the Committee on House Administration and the Joint Committee on the Library, and serves on the Appropriations Committee.

background.text: Born in Oneida County, New York; graduated from Eastridge High School and earned a bachelor's degree in political science from SUNY Geneseo.
Worked as president and CEO of MMI Technologies, Incorporated and as an administrator at the Anthony L. Jordan Health Center.
Served as a Monroe County legislator before his election to the New York State Assembly, where he later served as majority leader.

record.text: Serves as ranking member of the House Committee on House Administration (Modernization and Innovation Subcommittee) and the Joint Committee on the Library, and sits on the House Committee on Appropriations (Defense; Commerce, Justice, Science and Related Agencies subcommittees) in the 119th Congress.

summary.text: Virginia McIntyre is a Monroe County Legislator representing parts of Gates and Greece, running as the Republican and Conservative nominee on a platform of fiscal accountability, public safety and government transparency.

background.text: Earned a high school diploma from Gates Chili High School, an associate degree from Monroe Community College in 1998, a bachelor's degree from SUNY Purchase in 2001, and a second bachelor's degree from the Conservatorio di Mantova in 2005.
Worked as an educator, entrepreneur, international language professor and interpreter.
Has represented District 4 of the Monroe County Legislature since 2024 and was designated by the Monroe County Republican Committee to run for Congress.

priorities.text: Public safety, stronger local schools and expanding economic opportunity for working families.
Government accountability, transparency and fiscal responsibility, including tax relief for working families and seniors.
Says she has worked across party lines as a county legislator and will bring that approach to Congress.
priorities.quote: This campaign is about putting people over politics. I have worked across party lines to listen to constituents and act on their concerns, and I will bring that same approach to Washington.

positions.summary: Supports fiscal accountability, tax relief and responsible government spending rather than higher taxes.

sources.title: United States House of Representatives elections in New York, 2026

researchNotes: No campaign website was identified for Virginia McIntyre; her priorities and positions come from her 2026 Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey. Morelle has not completed a recent Candidate Connection survey and no current campaign-site issues page was accessible, so his priorities/positions are limited to what his official committee record documents. Federal key votes and FEC totals for incumbent Joseph Morelle are added separately by script.
